pages.title: 谱序列
pages.author: 孟晟
pages.text:
双复形、滤过与收敛
Hodge 与 Leray 谱序列

en.title: Spectral Sequences
en.author: Sheng Meng
en.text:
Double complexes, filtrations and convergence
Hodge and Leray spectral sequences

pages.title: 双复形
pages.text: 设 K 为第一象限双复形。两种微分分别增加一个指标；反交换关系使总微分的平方为零。

en.title: Double complex
en.text: Let K be a first-quadrant double complex. The differentials raise the two indices; anticommutation makes the total differential square to zero.

pages.title: 总复形
pages.text: 固定总次数 n，沿对角线取直和。第一象限条件保证每条对角线只有有限项。

en.title: Total complex
en.text: For each total degree n, sum along the diagonal. The first-quadrant condition makes this a finite direct sum.

diagram.title: 沿总次数对角线取直和

pages.title: 总上同调
pages.text: 闭元模去边界得到总上同调。两个闭元表示同一类，当且仅当它们相差一个总边界。

en.title: Total cohomology
en.text: Total cohomology is cycles modulo boundaries. Two cycles represent the same class exactly when their difference is a total boundary.

pages.title: 列滤过与子复形
pages.text: 保留第一指标至少为 p 的分量。横向微分提高第一指标，纵向微分保持它，故 D 保持列滤过。

en.title: Column filtration
en.text: Retain components with first index at least p. The horizontal differential raises that index and the vertical one preserves it, so D preserves the filtration.

diagram.title: 列滤过保留右侧分量
diagram.en: Column filtration retains the right-hand terms

pages.title: 上同调的诱导滤过
pages.text: 由子复形的包含在上同调上取像。FᵖHⁿ 中的类恰好具有属于 FᵖCⁿ 的闭代表元。

en.title: Induced filtration on cohomology
en.text: Take the image of the map induced by inclusion. These are precisely the cohomology classes with a closed representative in the filtered subcomplex.

pages.title: 关联分次
pages.text: 对相邻滤过层取商，得到关联分次复形。D 保持滤过，因而商上的微分良好定义。

en.title: Associated graded
en.text: Quotient adjacent filtration steps. Since D preserves the filtration, it induces a well-defined differential on this quotient.

pages.title: 滤过闭元与边界
pages.text: 这些都是原总复形中的子空间。分母的包含关系保证下一步定义的页空间确实是商空间。

en.title: Filtered cycles and boundaries
en.text: These are subspaces of the original total complex. The denominator inclusion ensures that the page quotient below is well defined.

pages.title: 一般页
pages.text: 在原滤过复形中构造 Eᵣ。它记录能将微分推入更深滤过层的代表元，并模去相应闭元与边界。

en.title: General page
en.text: Construct each page inside the original filtered complex, using representatives whose differential lies deeper in the filtration, modulo the specified cycles and boundaries.

pages.title: 页上的微分
pages.text: 总微分 D 诱导 dᵣ，双次数为 (r, 1−r)，总次数提高一。它把分母映入目标分母，故与代表元选择无关。

en.title: Page differential
en.text: The total differential induces a map of bidegree (r, 1−r). It carries the denominator into the target denominator, so it is independent of the representative.

pages.title: 逐页上同调
pages.text: 下一页自然同构于本页的上同调。自然映射先定义在闭元上；它不是从整个 Eᵣ 到下一页的任意投影。

en.title: Page cohomology
en.text: The next page is naturally isomorphic to cohomology of this page. The transition map is defined on cycles, not as a projection from the whole page.

pages.title: 逐位置稳定
pages.text: 出射靶的第二指标与入射源的第一指标均为负，故两个微分同时为零。稳定界依赖于位置 (p,q)。

en.title: Pointwise stabilization
en.text: Both differentials vanish because an index of their source or target is negative. The stabilization bound depends on the position (p,q).

pages.title: 第零页
pages.text: 取第 p 列分量给出自然识别。横向微分进入被商掉的部分，因此第零页只保留纵向微分。

en.title: Zeroth page
en.text: Projection onto column p gives the natural identification. The horizontal differential lands in the quotient denominator, leaving only the vertical differential.

pages.title: 第一象限收敛
pages.text: 每个总次数上的滤过有限，故谱序列收敛。稳定页识别的是关联分次；收敛本身不指定总上同调的典范直和分裂。

en.title: First-quadrant convergence
en.text: The filtration is finite in each total degree, so the sequence converges. The stable page identifies the associated graded, without choosing a canonical direct-sum splitting.

diagram.title: 稳定页沿总次数对角线收敛
diagram.en: Stable-page terms along a total-degree diagonal

pages.title: 退化与单行收敛
pages.tex: \begin{gathered}\begin{gathered}d_s^{p,q}=0\\(\forall s\ge r_0,\ \forall p,q)\end{gathered}\\[.35em]\begin{gathered}E_{r_0}^{p,q}\Longrightarrow H^{p+q}\\[.5em]\text{Then}\\[.4em](1)\ r_0\ge1,\quad E_{r_0}^{p,q}=0\ (p>0,\ q\ge0)\\\text{implies}\quad H^n\cong E_{r_0}^{0,n}.\\[.6em](2)\ r_0\ge2,\quad E_{r_0}^{p,q}=0\ (q>0,\ p\ge0)\\\text{implies}\quad E_{r_0}^{n,0}\cong H^n.\end{gathered}\end{gathered}
pages.text: 退化要求所有位置的后续微分同时为零。若仅有一行非零，每个总次数只有一个滤过商，从而直接识别目标上同调。

en.title: Degeneration and a single row
en.text: Degeneration requires all later differentials to vanish at every position. With only one nonzero row, the sole graded piece in each degree identifies the abutment.

blocks.tex: \begin{gathered}\begin{gathered}d_s^{p,q}=0\\(\forall s\ge r_0,\ \forall p,q)\end{gathered}\\[.35em]\begin{gathered}E_{r_0}^{p,q}\Longrightarrow H^{p+q}\\[.5em]\text{Then}\\[.4em](1)\ r_0\ge1,\quad E_{r_0}^{p,q}=0\ (p>0,\ q\ge0)\\\text{implies}\quad H^n\cong E_{r_0}^{0,n}.\\[.6em](2)\ r_0\ge2,\quad E_{r_0}^{p,q}=0\ (q>0,\ p\ge0)\\\text{implies}\quad E_{r_0}^{n,0}\cong H^n.\end{gathered}\end{gathered}

pages.title: 复微分形式
pages.tex: \begin{gathered}\dim_{\mathbb C}X=m,\\\mathcal A^{p,q}(X),\quad 0\le p,q\le m,\\\mathcal A^n(X;\mathbb C)=\bigoplus_{p+q=n}\mathcal A^{p,q}(X)\end{gathered}
pages.text: 设 X 为紧复流形。按型分解光滑复值微分形式；系数光滑，不要求全纯。

en.title: Complex differential forms
en.text: Let X be a compact complex manifold. Decompose smooth complex-valued forms by type; their coefficients need not be holomorphic.

pages.title: Dolbeault 双复形
pages.text: 由 d²=0 按双次数分解，得到两个平方零关系与反交换关系，因此总复形就是 de Rham 复形。

en.title: Dolbeault double complex
en.text: Decompose d squared by bidegree to obtain the double-complex identities. The total complex is the de Rham complex.

pages.title: Hodge–de Rham 谱序列
pages.text: Dolbeault 引理给出第一页的层上同调识别；第一象限收敛定理给出目标 de Rham 上同调。

en.title: Hodge–de Rham spectral sequence
en.text: The Dolbeault lemma identifies page one with sheaf cohomology; first-quadrant convergence identifies the de Rham abutment.

pages.title: Hodge 滤过
pages.text: Hodge 滤过由纯型分量的列滤过诱导。稳定页给出相邻层的商，此时尚未选择直和分裂。

en.title: Hodge filtration
en.text: The Hodge filtration is induced by the column filtration on types. The stable page gives adjacent quotients, before any splitting is chosen.

pages.title: ∂∂̄-引理与退化
pages.text: 进一步假设 X 为紧 Kähler 流形。∂∂̄-引理使每个 Dolbeault 类具有纯型的 d-闭代表元，故所有后续微分为零。

en.title: The ∂∂̄-lemma and degeneration
en.text: Assume X is compact Kähler. The dd-bar lemma provides a pure-type d-closed representative for each Dolbeault class, forcing all later differentials to vanish.

pages.title: 闭代表元与典范分裂
pages.text: 在满足 ∂∂̄ 条件的双复形中，以总闭代表元定义提升。两个选择之差为总边界，所以提升与选择无关。

en.title: Closed representatives and canonical splitting
en.text: Under the dd-bar condition, define lifts using total-closed representatives. Two choices differ by a total boundary, so the lifts are canonical.

pages.title: Hodge 分解
pages.text: 将上一条的典范提升应用于 Dolbeault 双复形。复共轭交换纯型指标，得到交集公式与 Hodge 对称性。

en.title: Hodge decomposition
en.text: Apply the canonical lifts to the Dolbeault complex. Complex conjugation exchanges types, yielding the intersection formula and Hodge symmetry.

pages.title: 几何设定
pages.text: 设 f 为域上概形的态射，𝓕 为 X 上拟凝聚层；目标是把 X 上的上同调与 Y 上的高阶直像联系起来。

en.title: Geometric setup
en.text: Let f be a morphism of schemes over a field and F a quasi-coherent sheaf. Relate cohomology on X to higher direct images on Y.

pages.title: 内射分解
pages.text: 在全部模层的范畴中取内射分解。后续的直像与截面运算均作用于这个明确选定的复形。

en.title: Injective resolution
en.text: Take an injective resolution in the category of all module sheaves. Direct image and global sections will be applied to this chosen complex.

pages.title: 直像复形
pages.text: 逐项取直像；复形的上同调层就是高阶直像。此时还没有取全局截面。

en.title: The pushforward complex
en.text: Take the direct image term by term. Its cohomology sheaves are the higher direct images; global sections have not yet been taken.

pages.title: 边界、闭元与上同调层
pages.text: 核与像都在层的范畴中取。微分平方为零保证边界层包含于闭元层，商层因而有定义。

en.title: Boundaries, cycles and cohomology sheaves
en.text: Kernels and images are taken as sheaves. A square-zero differential puts boundaries inside cycles, making the quotient sheaf well defined.

pages.title: 辅助内射分解
pages.text: 分别对边界层和上同调层取内射分解，为逐项拼接 Cartan–Eilenberg 分解准备材料。

en.title: Auxiliary injective resolutions
en.text: Resolve the boundary and cohomology sheaves separately, preparing the termwise Cartan–Eilenberg construction.

pages.title: 马蹄引理与逐项构造
pages.text: 依次对两条短正合列应用内射版马蹄引理。先拼出闭元层的分解，再拼出原复形各项的分解。

en.title: Horseshoe construction
en.text: Apply the injective horseshoe lemma twice: first to resolve cycles, then to resolve each term of the original complex.

pages.title: Cartan–Eilenberg 分解
pages.text: 每一行分解原复形的一项；纵向映射与横向微分相容，构成 Cartan–Eilenberg 内射双复形。

en.title: Cartan–Eilenberg resolution
en.text: Each row resolves one term of the original complex. Compatible vertical maps give a Cartan–Eilenberg injective double complex.

pages.title: 全局截面对象
pages.text: 逐项取 Y 上的全局截面，得到第一象限双分次对象。下一步再规定两种微分及符号。

en.title: The object of global sections
en.text: Take global sections on Y term by term, producing a first-quadrant bigraded object. Its differentials and signs are specified next.

pages.title: 微分与符号约定
pages.text: 层映射原本交换，纵向微分乘以符号 (−1)ᵖ 后得到反交换关系，从而总微分平方为零。

en.title: Differentials and signs
en.text: The sheaf maps commute. Multiplying the vertical differential by the sign makes the two differentials anticommute, so their sum squares to zero.

pages.title: 总复形与列滤过
pages.text: 使用与第一节相同的列滤过。先沿纵向取上同调，再沿横向取上同调，依次得到前两页。

en.title: Total complex and column filtration
en.text: Use the column filtration from Section 1. Vertical and then horizontal cohomology produce the first two pages.

pages.title: Leray 谱序列的第二页
pages.text: CE 分解中的相应短正合列分裂，因此截面函子在这些列上保持正合；再取横向上同调得到 E₂。

en.title: The second page of Leray
en.text: The relevant sequences in the CE resolution split, so global sections preserve their exactness. Horizontal cohomology then gives page two.

pages.title: 总上同调的识别
pages.text: 换一个方向先取上同调。内射层的直像为松层，对全局截面无高阶上同调，因此总复形计算 X 上的层上同调。

en.title: Identification of total cohomology
en.text: Take cohomology in the other direction. Direct images of injectives are flasque and acyclic for global sections, identifying the total cohomology on X.

pages.title: Leray 收敛
pages.text: 将第一象限收敛定理与上一条的总上同调识别结合，得到 Leray 收敛；第二页已由前面的构造明确给出。

en.title: Leray convergence
en.text: Combine first-quadrant convergence with the preceding total-cohomology identification to obtain Leray convergence, with the previously identified second page.

pages.title: 应用：由总上同调消失推出直像消失
pages.text: 在特征零的射影双有理设定下，充分正扭曲使高次底空间上同调消失，再结合消失定理推出高阶直像消失。

en.title: Application: vanishing of higher direct images
en.text: In the stated characteristic-zero projective birational setting, sufficient twisting kills higher base cohomology; the vanishing theorem then yields vanishing of higher direct images.

blocks.text: 应用：由总上同调消失推出直像消失
blocks.enText: Application: vanishing of higher direct images

pages.title: 应用：有理奇点与解消
pages.tex: \begin{gathered}\pi:\widetilde X\to X,\quad\pi_*\mathcal O_{\widetilde X}=\mathcal O_X\\R^q\pi_*\mathcal O_{\widetilde X}=0\quad(q>0)\\H^n(X,\mathcal O_X)\xrightarrow{\sim}H^n(\widetilde X,\mathcal O_{\widetilde X})\end{gathered}
pages.text: 取具有有理奇点的正规复簇及解消。高阶直像消失使第二页仅剩零行，单行收敛给出所示典范同构。

en.title: Application: rational singularities
en.text: For a normal complex variety with rational singularities and a resolution, higher direct images vanish. Single-row convergence gives the canonical isomorphism.

blocks.tex: \begin{gathered}\pi:\widetilde X\to X,\quad\pi_*\mathcal O_{\widetilde X}=\mathcal O_X\\R^q\pi_*\mathcal O_{\widetilde X}=0\quad(q>0)\\H^n(X,\mathcal O_X)\xrightarrow{\sim}H^n(\widetilde X,\mathcal O_{\widetilde X})\end{gathered}
